desc: Oats on Os! Start your day with the irresistible crunch of Cheerios Oat Crunch Almond breakfast cereal. This sweetened multigrain cereal is made with whole grain oats and topped with real almonds for a tasty part of an easy breakfast. Cheerios Oat Crunch Almond delivers a hearty bite in each bowl combining sweetened multigrain cereal and visible bunches of oats that bring a crunchy texture to each spoonful. Add Cheerios Oat Crunch to your grocery list with other whole grain oat favorites like oatmeal. Whether it's part of a breakfast, quick lunch, trail mix recipe or a bedtime snack, each serving of Oat Crunch Almond contains 13 vitamins & minerals and energy from 30g of whole grain (at least 48g recommended daily) that helps keep you going. This 18.2 oz Large Size box contains about 9 servings. Cheerios Oat Crunch is part of General Mills Big G Cereals that exist to spread goodness from tots to grown-ups.
features:
Crunchy Almond Satisfaction: Made with 25% more almonds, delivering a hearty crunch and nutty flavor 

Whole Grain Goodness: Each serving provides about 30 g of whole grains—roughly 60% of daily recommended intake 

Keeps You Full: Satiety studies show it helps adults feel full for ~3.5 hours when paired with skim milk 

Versatile: Great in breakfast bowls, yogurt parfaits, trail mixes, cereal bars, or eaten straight from the box
ingredients: Whole Grain Oats, Sugar, Whole Grain Corn, Modified Corn Starch, Canola and/or Sunflower Oil, Honey, Rice Flour, Salt, Corn Starch, Tripotassium Phosphate, Color (caramel color, annatto extract), Baking Soda, Natural Flavor, Rosemary Extract. Vitamin E (mixed tocopherols) Added to Preserve Freshness. Vitamins and Minerals: Tricalcium Phosphate, Calcium Carbonate, Iron and Zinc (mineral nutrients), Vitamin C (sodium ascorbate), A B Vitamin (niacinamide), A B Vitamin (calcium pantothenate), Vitamin B1 (thiamin mononitrate), Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine hydrochloride), Vitamin B2 (riboflavin), Vitamin B12, Vitamin A (palmitate), A B Vitamin (folic acid), Vitamin D3.
